name: Commander Zhalk
advice: Prepare Command on Shadowheart, make Zhalk drop the Everburn Blade, pick it up immediately, and leave before the reinforcements overwhelm the party.

name: Emerald Grove entrance
advice: Take high ground and focus the boss and Booyahg first. Do not loot friendly corpses while the grove defenders can see you.

name: Secluded Cove harpies
advice: Use Calm Emotions or Silence to stop Luring Song, protect Mirkon with Sanctuary, and focus the singing harpy.

name: Phase Spider Matriarch
enemies: Phase Spider Matriarch, phase spiders, spiderlings
advice: Bring fire or acid, destroy egg clutches out of her line of sight, burn webs beneath her for fall damage, and keep her prone.

name: Owlbear mother
advice: Enter rested, avoid standing together for Crushing Flight, and burst one adult at a time. The encounter can also be resolved without fighting.

name: Blighted Village
advice: Talk through the gate when possible, then clear isolated groups from high ground instead of aggroing the whole village.

name: Goblin leaders
enemies: Priestess Gut, Minthara, Dror Ragzlin and guards
advice: Isolate Gut, remove war drums, clear side rooms, and leave Ragzlin for last. Do not turn the entire sanctum hostile before the party has an exit plan.

name: Sunlit Wetlands redcaps
advice: Start from range, use the terrain choke, and prevent the redcaps from surrounding a low-Armour-Class character.

name: Druid Sanctuary guardians
enemies: Wood woads and ancient mud mephits
advice: Do not bunch up for mephit explosions. Focus the summoners and use fire against the wood woads.

name: Auntie Ethel
advice: Bring Magic Missile or multi-hit attacks for duplicates, water for Mayrina's cage, and avoid killing Ethel before triggering the hair reward if the build needs it.

name: Risen Road gnolls
advice: Approach with high ground, use the tadpole option on Flind when available, and focus archers before they can stack multiattack pressure.

name: Underdark minotaurs and bulette
advice: Use the outpost gate and elevation, keep the party spread for the bulette, and do not chase a burrowing target into another encounter.

name: Spectator
advice: Pre-position before the trigger, burst the Spectator, and use protection from control effects. Charmed drow can be freed by damaging them.

name: Arcane Tower guardians
enemies: Bernard and animated armour if dialogue fails
advice: Read the tower poetry before speaking to Bernard. The correct dialogue avoids the fight and preserves the reward options.

name: Sussur Tree hook horrors
advice: Pull one hook horror at a time, use the branches for elevation, and avoid fighting the whole nest while the bulette is active nearby.

name: True Soul Nere
advice: Recruit Elder Brithvar's faction before freeing Nere, remove scrying eyes first, and keep characters away from lava and ledges.

name: Grym
advice: Keep lava active to make Grym vulnerable, use bludgeoning damage, and position one character at the forge lever before starting.

name: Githyanki patrol
advice: A successful dialogue is safest. If fighting, pre-position on the bridge, use control immediately, and focus the highest-damage martial first.

name: Inquisitor W'wargaz
advice: Enter fully rested, spread before dialogue ends, remove the Inquisitor quickly, and be ready for the Honour legendary action that punishes repeated attacks.
